props.name: data
props.description: The bytes to show. Never copied, so a large buffer costs only the rows on screen.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the byte grid.

props.name: defaultBytesPerRow
props.description: Initial bytes per row; the reader can change it.

props.name: rows
props.description: Visible rows before the grid scrolls.

props.name: baseOffset
props.description: Added to every displayed offset — for a slice taken from the middle of a file.
